楚凝离开后的第二天就传来她被杀了的消息，楚夜对楚凝还是有些感情的，听到楚凝被人杀了，发了好大的脾气。

叶清秋让人将楚夜带下去，看着被盖住的尸体，满心的疑虑。

她明明将尸体扔了，为什么会出现在这里？

难不成有人看到她杀了楚凝，以此来警告她？

会是谁……

叶清秋神色凝重的回了房，楚夜就坐在房间中，他看到叶清秋，眼眶隐隐发红，叶清秋心头一跳，站在原地没在前进。

楚夜却直接奔了过来，一把抱住叶清秋，“宗主。”

叶清秋僵了僵，确定楚夜不是发现了什么，才拍了拍了他的后背，“虽然她做了一些不好的事，但是你放心，我会替她报仇的。”

楚夜长得也不差，而且床上功夫也不错，叶清秋之前倒也不是不喜欢他，只是觉得他身份配不上自己，但是现在睡都睡过了，也没什么好别扭的。

安慰着安慰着，两人就滚到床上去了。

等结束一轮，楚夜趴在床上，累得眼皮都抬不起来。

叶清秋却是精神饱满，红光满面，睨了已经睡过去的楚夜一眼，神色蓦的变得讥讽起来，她掐了个诀，床榻上忽的出现一条水龙。

炉鼎……

用好了，还指不定谁是炉鼎呢。

这是她上次和楚夜之后发现的，本来还差一点的才能进入筑基大圆满，可是在和楚夜之后，直接就跨过了那个槛。

水灵根是修真界公认的炉鼎，可是她似乎不是被采的那个。

她后来问了那个魔族，他告诉她是因为他的存在，所以她从被采的那个变成了采的那个。

刚才她实验了一下，他说得果然没错。

叶清秋目光落在楚夜身上，再次覆身上去，楚夜迷迷糊糊的，但是一接触到叶清秋的身体，他本能的开始回应她。

“听说又有人失踪了？”几名桐山派的弟子一边交谈一边下山。

“这是第几个了？师尊让我们暗中找，可是这人多眼杂的，我们怎么找啊？我看啊，指不定就是那边那两个干的。”其中一个男弟子朝着远处的山峰努了努嘴。

“嘘，不想活了。”旁边的人立即打了那个男弟子一下，“这种话千万不要乱说，师尊说了，这事和他们应该没关系。”

“咦，为什么？”

The day after Chu Ning left, news came that she had been killed. Chu Ye still had some feelings for Chu Ning. When he heard that Chu Ning had been killed, he lost his temper.

Ye Qingqiu asked people to take Chu Ye down and looked at the covered body, full of doubts.

She obviously threw the body away, why is she here?

Could it be possible that someone saw her killing Chu Ning to warn her?

Who could it be...

Ye Qingqiu returned to the room with a solemn expression. Chu Ye was sitting in the room. When he saw Ye Qingqiu, his eyes were faintly red. Ye Qingqiu's heart skipped a beat and he stood there without moving forward.

But Chu Ye ran directly over and hugged Ye Qingqiu, "Sect Master."

Ye Qingqiu froze and made sure that Chu Ye hadn't discovered anything before patting his back. "Although she did some bad things, don't worry, I will avenge her."

Chu Ye wasn't bad looking, and he was also good in bed. It wasn't that Ye Qingqiu didn't like him before, but he just felt that his status was not worthy of her, but now that he had slept with him, there was nothing to feel awkward about.

After comforting each other, the two rolled onto the bed.

When the round was over, Chu Ye lay on the bed, so tired that he couldn't even raise his eyelids.

Ye Qingqiu was full of energy, with a red face. He glanced at Chu Ye who had fallen asleep, and his expression suddenly became sarcastic. She made a gesture, and a water dragon suddenly appeared on the bed.

Furnace tripod...

After using it, I still can’t tell who the furnace cauldron is.

This was what she discovered after her last encounter with Chu Ye. She was still a little short of entering the Foundation Establishment Perfection, but after her encounter with Chu Ye, she directly crossed that threshold.

Shuilinggen is a recognized furnace in the world of cultivation, but she doesn't seem to be the one who was picked.

She later asked the demon, and he told her that it was because of his existence that she changed from the one who was picked to the one who picked her.

She tested it just now, and what he said was indeed right.

Ye Qingqiu's eyes fell on Chu Ye and covered him again. Chu Ye was dazed, but as soon as he came into contact with Ye Qingqiu's body, he instinctively began to respond to her.

"I heard that someone is missing again?" Several disciples of the Tongshan Sect were talking while going down the mountain.

"Which number is this? Master asked us to search secretly, but this man is too arrogant. How can we find him? I think it might be those two over there who did it." One of the male disciples nuzzled towards the distant mountain peak.

"Shh, I don't want to live anymore." The person next to him immediately hit the male disciple, "Don't say such nonsense. Master said, this matter should have nothing to do with them."

"Hey, why?"
